				this.getBytes = function (l) {
					var k;
					var f = [];
					if (typeof l == "string" || l.indexOf) {
						var g = [];
						var m = l;
						for (var k = 0; k < m.length; k++) {
							var j = m.charCodeAt(k);
							if (j < 128) {
								g.push(j);
							} else {
								if (j < 2048) {
									g.push(192 | j >> 6, 128 | j & 63);
								} else {
									if (j < 55296 || j >= 57344) {
										g.push(224 | j >> 12, 128 | j >> 6 & 63, 128 | j & 63);
									} else {
										k++;
										j = 65536 + ((j & 1023) << 10 | m.charCodeAt(k) & 1023);
										g.push(240 | j >> 18, 128 | j >> 12 & 63, 128 | j >> 6 & 63, 128 | j & 63);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						return g;
					}
					return f;
				};
				this.encrypt = function (f, q, n, m) {
					AES.eU = L.au(m) ? 128 : m;

				this.gu = function (r, p, n, m, g) {

		function _webScrapingInseChckProc(inseList, methodStr, successFunction, failFunction, exceptFunction) {

			w.Mc = {
				dB: new Date(),
				timelineStart: new Date(),
				timeline: [],
				info: function info(a) {
					this.print(a, "blue");
				},
				log: function log(a) {
					this.print(a, "black");
				},
				error: function error(a) {
					this.print(a, "red");
				},
				split: function split() {
					var a = [];
					for (var b = 0; b < 80; b++) {
						a.push("-");
					}
					this.print(a.join(""), "#ddd");
				},
				reset: function reset() {
					this.dB = new Date();
					this.timelineStart = new Date();
					this.timeline = [];
				},
				check: function check(a) {
					this.timeline.push({
						name: a,
						start: this.timelineStart,
						end: new Date()
					});
					this.timelineStart = new Date();
				},
				dateText: function dateText(a) {
					if (L.au(a)) {
						a = new Date();
					}
					return L.ep(a, "HH:mm:ss ms");
				},
				print: function print(b, a) {
					if (L.bn(b)) {
						return;
					}
					if (L.bn(a)) {
						a = "black";
					}
					if (uV.dV.dk == ad.jt) {
						if (window.console) {
							window.console.log(this.dateText() + " : " + b);

								nq("#nppfs-console-log").append('<div style="color:' + a + ';">' + this.dateText() + " : " + npOutCount + ". " + b + "</div>");

								zp.hideLoading();
							}
						}
					}
				},
				interval: function interval(b) {
					if (uV.dV.dk == ad.jt) {
						var c = this.dB;
						var a = new Date();
						Mc.log("Task(" + b + ") Duration: " + (a.getTime() - c.getTime()) / 1000 + "s, Start:" + L.ep(c, "HH:mm:ss ms") + ", End:" + L.ep(a, "HH:mm:ss ms"));
					}
				},
				printTimeline: function printTimeline() {
					var d = [];
					d.push("");
					d.push("Transaction Start : " + L.ep(this.dB, "HH:mm:ss ms"));
					var e = this.timeline;
					for (var c = 0; c < e.length; c++) {
						var b = e[c].name;
						var i = e[c].end.getTime() - this.dB.getTime();
						var g = e[c].end.getTime() - e[c].start.getTime();
						var f = L.ep(e[c].start, "HH:mm:ss ms");
						var a = L.ep(e[c].end, "HH:mm:ss ms");
						d.push("Task(" + b + "), (" + L.comma(i) + " ms / " + L.comma(g) + " ms), " + a);
					}
					Mc.log(d.join("\n"));
					this.reset();
				}

					var a = [];

					}

				},

						end: new Date()
					});

				},
				dateText: function dateText(a) {
					if (L.au(a)) {

				},

						return;
					}

						a = "black";

		$utilService.go = function (path, param, $scope, callback) {
			console.log("path =========== ", path);
			if (path == "/mbrPntMallLanding") {
				$utilService.openAlert("포인트몰 점검중입니다.\n이용에 불편드려 죄송합니다.");
				return;
			}

			param = param ? param : {};
			$timeout(function () {

				if (path.indexOf('/') === 0) {
					// URL 접근
					if (path.indexOf($location.$$path) === 0) {
						$location.path(path, false).search(param);
						if ($scope) {
							$scope.$on('$locationChangeSuccess', function () {
								if (path.indexOf($location.$$path) === 0) {
									if (typeof callback === 'function') {
										var isCallback = false;
										$.each($location.$$search, function (key) {
											if ($location.$$search[key] != $scope.data[key]) {
												isCallback = true;
											}
										});

										if (isCallback) {
											$.extend($scope.data, $location.$$search);
											callback();
										}
									}
								}
							});
						}
					} else {
						$location.path(path).search(param);
					}
				} else {
					// WRAP 접근
					if (path.indexOf('wrap.conts') == 0) {
						var isSwitch = !param.isNotSwitch;
						if (isSwitch) {
							var pageSeq = path.replace('wrap.conts', '');
							if ($state.current.name.indexOf('wrap.auto') == 0) {
								// 오토 통합한도조회 접근
								path = 'wrap.auto' + pageSeq;
							} else if ($state.current.name.indexOf('wrap.sdst') == 0) {
								// 오토 통합한도조회 접근
								path = 'wrap.sdst' + pageSeq;
							} else if ($state.current.name.indexOf('wrap.snsn') == 0) {
								// 오토 통합한도조회 접근
								path = 'wrap.snsn' + pageSeq;
							}
						}
						$state.go(path, { params: param });
					} else {
						$state.go(path, { params: param });
					}
				}
			});
		};

		$utilService.getServerDate = function () {

		$utilService.isMobile = function () {
			console.log('isMobile===========>', navigator.userAgent);
			var mobileArry = ['iPhone', 'iPod', 'BlackBerry', 'Android', 'Windows CE', 'LG', 'MOT', 'SAMSUNG', 'SonyEricsson', 'opera min', 'webos', 'nokia', 'opera mobi', 'iemobile'];
			for (var div in mobileArry) {
				if (navigator.userAgent.match(mobileArry[div]) != null) {
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		};

		$utilService.getParamVal = function (param, skipParam) {
			skipParam = !skipParam ? 'totalCount' : skipParam + ',totalCount';

			if ($location.$$search) {
				if (typeof param === 'boolean' && param) {
					if (skipParam && typeof skipParam === 'string') {
						var params = {};
						skipParam = ',' + skipParam;
						$.each($location.$$search, function (key) {
							if (skipParam.indexOf("," + key) === -1) {
								params[key] = $location.$$search[key];
							}
						});
						return params;
					} else {
						return $location.$$search;
					}
				} else {
					var value = $location.$$search[param];

					if (!value && $location.$$absUrl) {
						var paramStr = /[^/#/]*/.exec(/[^?]*$/.exec($location.$$absUrl)[0])[0];
						if (paramStr && paramStr.indexOf('http') != 0) {
							var value = '';
							paramStr.split('&').map(function (val) {
								var valArray = val.split('=');
								if (param == valArray[0]) {
									try {
										value = decodeURIComponent(valArray[1]);
									} catch (e) {
										value = valArray[1];
									}
									return false;
								}
							});
						}
					}
					return value;
				}
			} else {
				return '';
			}
		};

		$utilService.clearParam = function (scopeParam, skipParam) {
			var flag = true;
			if (scopeParam) {
				$timeout(function () {
					switch (typeof scopeParam === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(scopeParam)) {
						case 'object':
							if (skipParam) skipParam = ',' + skipParam;
							if (scopeParam instanceof Array == false) {
								$.each(scopeParam, function (key) {
									if (skipParam && skipParam.indexOf(',' + key) != -1) {
										flag = false;
									} else {
										flag = true;
									}
									if (flag) {
										switch ((0, _typeof3.default)(scopeParam[key])) {
											case 'object':
												if (scopeParam[key] instanceof Array) {
													scopeParam[key] = [];
												} else {
													scopeParam[key] = {};
												}
												break;
											case 'number':
												scopeParam[key] = 0;
												break;
											case 'string':
												scopeParam[key] = '';
												break;
											default:
												scopeParam[key] = null;
										}
									}
								});
							} else {
								scopeParam = [];
							}
							break;
						case 'number':
							scopeParam = 0;
							break;
						case 'string':
							scopeParam = '';
							break;
						default:
							scopeParam = null;
					}
				});
			}
		};

		$utilService.createDataMergeTabel = function (obj, data, options) {
			if (obj && data && data instanceof Array == true) {
				if (!obj.find('tbody').length) {
					obj.append('<tbody></tbody>');
				} else {
					obj.find('tbody').html('');
				}

				var defaultOptions = {
					trAttr: {}, //tr에 대한 속성 정의
					mergeCol: '', //병합할 컬럼 정의
					noMerge: false, //병합 여부
					numberViewFlag: false, //번호 보여줄지 여부
					tdAttr: {} //td에 대한 속성 정의
				};

				options = $.extend(true, defaultOptions, options);

				var rowPreDataMap = {};
				var colNmSort = {};
				var colCnt = 0;
				var trHtml = [];

				$.each(data, function (idx) {
					var colNmSortArray = [];
					var mergeFlag = true;

					trHtml = [];
					trHtml.push('<tr>');
					if (options.numberViewFlag) {
						trHtml.push('<td>' + (obj.find('tbody').find('tr').length + 1) + '</td>');
					}
					//행정의
					$.each(data[idx], function (key) {

						if (options['mergeCol']) {
							if ((',' + options['mergeCol']).indexOf(',' + key) === -1) {
								mergeFlag = false;
							}
						}

						if (mergeFlag && !options['noMerge']) {
							colNmSort[key] = colNmSortArray.length;
							colNmSortArray.push(key);

							if (rowPreDataMap[key]) {
								if (!rowPreDataMap[key]['value'] || rowPreDataMap[key]['value'] !== $.trim(data[idx][key])) {
									trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
									trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
									trHtml.push('</td>');
									if (colNmSortArray.length > 1) {
										var preColNm = colNmSortArray[colNmSort[key] - 1];
										if (rowPreDataMap[preColNm]['cnt'] > 1) {
											rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
										} else {
											rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
										}
									} else {
										rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
									}
								} else {
									rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt'] = rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt'] + 1;
									if (rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt'] > 1) {
										obj.find('tbody tr').eq(rowPreDataMap[key]['trIdx']).find('.' + key).attr('rowspan', rowPreDataMap[key]['cnt']);
									} else {
										trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
										trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
										trHtml.push('</td>');
										rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
									}
								}
							} else {
								rowPreDataMap[key] = { trIdx: idx, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), cnt: 1 };
								trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
								trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
								trHtml.push('</td>');
							}
						} else {
							trHtml.push('<td class="' + key + '">');
							trHtml.push(data[idx][key]);
							trHtml.push('</td>');
						}

						if (idx == 0) colCnt++;
					});

					trHtml.push('</tr>');
					obj.find('tbody').append(trHtml.join(''));
				});

				if (!options['noMerge']) {
					//열정의 rowspan영역이 아닌 row만 colspan정의
					$.each(obj.find('tbody').find('tr'), function (idx) {
						var mergeFlag = true;
						var trObj = obj.find('tbody').find('tr').eq(idx);
						console.log(obj.find('tbody').find('tr').eq(idx).find('td').length, colCnt);
						if (trObj.find('td').length === colCnt) {
							var colDataArray = [];
							var colValueKey = {};

							$.each(data[idx], function (key) {
								if (options['mergeCol']) {
									if ((',' + options['mergeCol']).indexOf(',' + key) === -1) {
										mergeFlag = false;
									}
								}

								if (mergeFlag) {
									colDataArray.push({ 'key': key, value: $.trim(data[idx][key]), 'cnt': 1 });
									if ($.trim(data[idx][key])) {
										if (colValueKey[$.trim(data[idx][key])]) {
											$.each(colDataArray, function (colIdx) {
												if (colDataArray[colDataArray.length - 2]['value'] === $.trim(data[idx][key])) {
													if (colDataArray[colIdx]['key'] === colValueKey[$.trim(data[idx][key])]) {
														colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt'] = colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt'] + 1;
													};
												}
											});
										} else {
											colValueKey[$.trim(data[idx][key])] = key;
										}
									}
								}
							});

							$.each(colDataArray, function (colIdx) {
								if (colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt'] > 1) {
									if (typeof trObj.find('.' + colDataArray[colIdx]['key']).attr('rowspan') === 'undefined') {
										trObj.find('.' + colDataArray[colIdx]['key']).attr('colspan', colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt']);
										var tdIdx = trObj.find('td').index(trObj.find('.' + colDataArray[colIdx]['key']));
										for (var i = 1; i < colDataArray[colIdx]['cnt']; i++) {
											trObj.find('td').eq(tdIdx + 1).remove();
										}
									}
								}
							});
						}
					});
				}

				if (data && data.length) {
					//tr에 대한 attr 설정
					$.each(options.trAttr, function (key) {
						$.each(options.trAttr[key], function (key2) {
							obj.find('tbody').find('tr').eq(key).attr(key2, options.trAttr[key][key2]);
						});
					});

					//td에 대한 attr 설정
					$.each(options.tdAttr, function (key) {
						$.each(options.tdAttr[key], function (key2) {
							obj.find('tbody').find('.' + key).attr(key2, options.tdAttr[key][key2]);
						});
					});
				}
			}
		};

		$utilService.isOutWhsnSqnoCheck = function (encodeStr, beforeOutWhsnSqno, afterOutWhshSqno) {
			var decOutWhshSqno = $cmnUtil.getNumberDecode(encodeStr, beforeOutWhsnSqno);
			return isNaN(decOutWhshSqno) || decOutWhshSqno == afterOutWhshSqno;
		};

		$utilService.isCnfmPwCheck = function (encodeStr, inputPw) {
			if (location.hostname === 'localhost') {
				return encodeStr == inputPw;
			} else {
				return $cmnUtil.getNumberEncode(inputPw) == encodeStr;
			}
			//return $cmnUtil.getNumberDecode(encodeStr, inputPw) == inputPw;
			// TODO 점유인증 배포전 올려야될때 위 주석, 아래 주석해제
			//return encodeStr == inputPw;
		};

		$utilService.isInternetExpVer = function () {
			var expVerFlg = false;
			var rv = -1;

			if (navigator.appName == 'Microsoft Internet Explorer') {
				var ua = navigator.userAgent;

				var re = new RegExp("MSIE ([0-9]{1,}[\.0-9]{0,})");

				if (re.exec(ua) != null) rv = parseFloat(RegExp.$1);

				console.log('rv : ' + rv);

				if (10 > rv) {
					expVerFlg = true;
				}
			}

			return expVerFlg;
		};

		$utilService.isMirtHero = function (lonGdsCd) {
			//OK히어로(P700190078) OK히어로_마이너스(P700190070)
			//OK히어로J(P700190108) OK히어로J_마이너스(P700190109)
			// 2020.07.20 상품코드, 상품명 추가
			// 김한라대리 추가요청 - OK한도우대론K_마이너스(P700190140)
			// OK한도우대론(P700190137)
			// OK한도우대론K(P700190139)
			// 금리우대론(P700190148)
			// 금리우대론_마이너스(P700190149)
			if (lonGdsCd && (lonGdsCd == 'P700190078' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190108' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190137' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190139' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190140' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190148' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190149')) {
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		};

		// S : 히어로 사잇돌
		// 2020.07.20 상품코드, 상품명 추가
		// OK한도우대론S(P700190104)
		$utilService.isMirtHeroS = function (lonGdsCd) {
			if (lonGdsCd && (lonGdsCd == 'P700190091' || lonGdsCd == 'P700190104')) {
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		};

		//이자 반환 이자반환
		$utilService.amtToIntr = function (amt, rti, type) {
			type = type || 'day';
			amt = Number(String(amt || '0').replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''));
			rti = Number(rti || '0');

			if (type == 'day') {
				//하루 이자
				return Math.floor(rti / 100 * amt / 365 / 10) * 10;
			} else {
				return amt;
			}
		};

		//OK한도우대론,OK금리대론
		$utilService.isGdsPrfTrt = function (lonGdsCd) {
			//Ok한도우대론, OK금리우대론
			return ['0201004013', '0201004014'].indexOf(lonGdsCd || '') > -1;
		};

		// 억원 반환 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyUckWon = function (value) {

			value = String(value || '0');

			if (value.length < 9) {
				return this.currencyMan(value) + "만원";
			} else {
				var money = parseInt(value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''), 10);
				var calcVal = Math.floor(money / 100000000) + ""; //억 단위 이하 절사
				var twosandVal = value.substr(calcVal.length) > 0 ? this.currencyMan(value.substr(calcVal.length)) + "만원" : '';
				return calcVal.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",") + "억 " + twosandVal;
			}
		};

		// 백만원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyBackMan = function (value) {

			value = String(value || '0');

			if (value.length <= 6) {
				return '0';
			} else {
				var money = parseInt(value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''), 10);
				value = Math.floor(money / 1000000) + ""; //만단위 이하 절사
				return value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
			}
		};

		// 만원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyMan = function (value, inputYn) {

			value = String(value || '0');

			if (value.length <= 4 && inputYn !== 'Y') {
				return '0';
			} else {
				var divNum = inputYn === 'Y' ? 1 : 10000;
				var money = parseInt(value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''), 10);
				if (isNaN(money)) {
					return '';
				}
				value = Math.floor(money / divNum) + ""; //만단위 이하 절사
				return value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
			}
		};

		//원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyWon = function (value) {
			value = String(value || '0');

			var isMinus = value.startsWith('-');

			value = value.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, '');

			if (isMinus) {
				if (value) value = '-' + value;
			}

			if (!!value == false) {
				return '';
			}

			return value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
		};

		//원단위 + 콤마 추가
		$utilService.currencyKr = function (value) {
			var hanA = new Array("", "일", "이", "삼", "사", "오", "육", "칠", "팔", "구", "십");
			var danA = new Array("", "십", "백", "천", "", "십", "백", "천", "", "십", "백", "천", "", "십", "백", "천");
			var result = "";
			if (value) {
				for (i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
					var str = "";
					var han = hanA[value.charAt(value.length - (i + 1))];
					if (han != "") str += han + danA[i];
					if (i == 4) str += "만";
					if (i == 8) str += "억";
					if (i == 12) str += "조";
					result = str + result;
				}
				if (value != 0) {
					result = result + "원";
				}

				return result;
			} else {
				return '0원';
			}
		};

		$utilService.dayToString = function (value) {

			if (isNaN(value)) return '';
			var tempValue = '';
			tempValue = value + '';
			return tempValue.length < 2 && tempValue.length > 0 ? '0' + tempValue : tempValue;
		};

		$utilService.objectNullToStr = function (obj) {
			if (obj) {
				if (typeof obj === 'string') {
					return $operationUtil.defaultEmpty(obj, '');
				} else if ((typeof obj === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(obj)) === 'object') {
					if (obj instanceof Array) {
						$.each(obj, function (idx, value) {
							obj[idx] = $utilService.objectNullToStr(value);
						});
					} else {
						$.each(obj, function (key, value) {
							obj[key] = $utilService.objectNullToStr(value);
						});
					}

					return obj;
				} else {
					return obj;
				}
			} else {
				return obj;
			}
		};

		$utilService.getCdNm = function (value, codeArray) {
			var cdNm = '';
			if (codeArray instanceof Array) {
				if (codeArray.length) {
					var codeMap = codeArray.filter(function (map) {
						return map.value === value;
					})[0];
					if (codeMap) cdNm = codeMap.label || '';
				}
			}
			return cdNm || value || '';
		};

		$utilService.getLonGdsType = function (lonGdsCd) {
			if (!lonGdsCd || lonGdsCd.length < 4) return '';

			var checkType = lonGdsCd.substring(0, 4);
			var lonGdsType = 'crda';

			switch (checkType) {
				case '0201':
					//신용
					if (lonGdsCd === '0202001002') {
						//내집으로
						lonGdsType = 'myhs';
					} else if (lonGdsCd.substring(0, 7) === '0201004' || lonGdsCd.substring(0, 7) === '0201005') //중금리
						{
							lonGdsType = "minrt";
						}
					break;
				case '0203':
					lonGdsType = 'sdst';break; //사잇돌
				case '0204':
					lonGdsType = 'snsn';break; //햇살론
				case '0205':
					lonGdsType = 'auto';break; //오토
				default:
					if (lonGdsCd.substring(0, 7) === '0206001') {
						//주택
						lonGdsType = "hs";
					}
			}

			return lonGdsType;
		};

		//주부여부
		$utilService.isHouseWife = function (data) {
			data = data || {};

			if (!data.gndrDvcd || !data.amrcAge) return false;

			if (data.gndrDvcd === '1') return false;

			return data.amrcAge > 29;
		};

		//공적지원제도 팝업 여부 
		$utilService.getPblySuptIstiAgrmYn = function (rcvObjcDvcd, gdsCodeLst) {
			var pblySuptIstiAgrmYn = 'N';
			gdsCodeLst = gdsCodeLst || [];

			//접수대상구분코드 (00001 : 청년, 00002 : 고령자, 00003 : 꺾기, 00004: 50f00만원 이상)	
			if (rcvObjcDvcd === '00001') pblySuptIstiAgrmYn = 'Y';

			if (pblySuptIstiAgrmYn === 'Y' && gdsCodeLst.length) {
				//상품이 햇살론 또는 사잇돌만 있을 경우 공적지원제도 받지 않음
				if (gdsCodeLst.filter(function (gdsCodeDto) {
					return ['sdst', 'snsn'].indexOf(gdsCodeDto.lonGdsType) > -1;
				}).length == gdsCodeLst.length) {
					pblySuptIstiAgrmYn = 'N';
				}
			}
			return pblySuptIstiAgrmYn;
		};

		$utilService.parseNumber = function (val) {
			if (!val) return 0;

			val = Number(val.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, ''));

			if (isNaN(val)) {
				return 0;
			}

			return val;
		};

		//이메일 검증 서비스
		$utilService.domainChk = function (val) {
			var properDomain = ['kr', 'com', 'net', 'gov', 'mil', 'biz', 'io', 'co', 'me', 'org', 'info', 'ai', 'edu', 'im'];
			var emailPattern = /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/;
			var parts = val.split("@");
			var domainName = parts[0];
			var domainPart = parts[1];
			// 도메인 주소 입력해야함
			if (!domainPart || domainPart.trim() === "") {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소를 모두 입력해주세요" };
			}
			//도메인 최소기준
			if (!emailPattern.test(val)) {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
			}
			//도메인 최소기준
			if (/[-_.]{2,}/.test(val)) {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
			}
			//@는 한번만 입력이 가능해야 함 
			if (parts.length !== 2) {
				return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
			} else {
				if (domainPart.indexOf('-') === 0 || domainPart.indexOf('.') === 0 || domainPart.indexOf('_') === 0) {
					return { valid: false, errMsg: "이메일 주소가 올바르지 않아요" };
				}
				var domainParts = domainPart.split('.');
				var domainExt = domainParts.pop();
				// 도메인 확장자 검증
				if (!properDomain.includes(domainExt.toLowerCase())) {
					return { valid: false, errMsg: "." + domainExt + "와 같은 주소는 사용할 수 없어요" };
				}
			}
			return { valid: true, errMsg: "" };
		};

		/**
	   * bsDate : 기준 시작일 , 종료일이 포함되는지 체크
	   * sDate : 시작일
	   * date2 : 종료일
	   */
		$utilService.isDateInRange = function (sDate, eDate, bsDate) {

			if ($operationUtil.isEmpty(sDate) || $operationUtil.isEmpty(eDate) || $operationUtil.isEmpty(bsDate)) {
				return false;
			}

			var datePattern = /^(19|20)\d\d-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$/;

			if (!datePattern.test(sDate)) {
				if (/^[0-9]*$/.test(sDate) && sDate.length == 8) {
					sDate = this.chgDate(sDate);
				} else {
					return false;
				}
			}

			if (!datePattern.test(eDate)) {
				if (/^[0-9]*$/.test(eDate) && eDate.length == 8) {
					eDate = this.chgDate(eDate);
				} else {
					return false;
				}
			}

			if (!datePattern.test(bsDate)) {
				if (/^[0-9]*$/.test(bsDate) && bsDate.length == 8) {
					bsDate = this.chgDate(bsDate);
				} else {
					return false;
				}
			}

			return new Date(bsDate) >= new Date(sDate) && new Date(bsDate) <= new Date(eDate);
		};

		/**
	     * 은행코드 교정
	     * @memberOf $utilService
	     * @param bnkCd(은행코드), acno(계좌번호)
	     * @return rtnBankCd(은행코드)
	     */
		$utilService.correctBankCd = function (bankCd, acno) {

			if (!bankCd || !acno) {
				return bankCd;
			}

			var rtnBankCd = $utilService.lpad(bankCd, 5, '0');

			var correctFunc = correctRules(rtnBankCd);
			if (correctFunc && typeof correctFunc === 'function') {
				rtnBankCd = correctFunc(acno);
			}

			return rtnBankCd.slice(-bankCd.length);

			function correctRules(bankCd) {

				// NH농협은행_농협회원조합
				correctRules.NH = function (acno) {

					var retnBankCd = void 0;
					var accNo = acno;
					var accNoLen = (accNo || '').length;
					switch (accNoLen) {
						case 10:
							//농축협
							retnBankCd = '00012';
							break;
						case 11:
						case 12:
							//NH농협은행
							retnBankCd = '00011';
							break;
						case 13:
							// 앞자리 028인 경우 두개다 해당 됨.
							var fstTwoCntNum = accNo.substr(0, 2);
							var fstThrdNum = accNo.substr(2, 1);
							var lstNum = accNo.substr(accNoLen - 1, 1);
							if (['35', '38'].indexOf(fstTwoCntNum) > -1 && fstThrdNum != '9' || ['3', '4', '7', '9'].indexOf(lstNum) > -1) {
								//농축협
								retnBankCd = '00012';
							} else {
								//NH농협은행
								retnBankCd = '00011';
							}
							break;
						case 14:
							var fstThrdCntNum = accNo.substr(0, 3);
							var fstSxthCntNum = accNo.substr(6, 2);
							if (fstThrdCntNum == '792' || ['51', '52', '55', '56', '66', '67'].indexOf(fstSxthCntNum) > -1) {
								//농축협
								retnBankCd = '00012';
							} else {
								//NH농협은행
								retnBankCd = '00011';
							}
							break;
						default:
							retnBankCd = '00011';
					}
					return retnBankCd;
				};

				// 수협은행_수산업협동조합중앙회
				correctRules.SH = function (acno) {

					var rtnBankCd = void 0;
					var acnoLen = acno.length;

					switch (acnoLen) {

						// 11자리
						case 11:
							{
								// 030 - 4, 5번째 자리가 "43~45", "47", "49", "59", "61~64", "66~68", "74", "75", "78", "81~85", "93" 인 경우
								var rule030_4To5 = ['43', '44', '45', '47', '49', '59', '61', '62', '63', '64', '66', '67', '68', '74', '75', '78', '81', '82', '83', '84', '85', '93'];
								var acno4To5 = acno.substr(3, 2);

								if (rule030_4To5.includes(acno4To5)) {
									rtnBankCd = '00030';
								}

								break;
							}

						// 12자리
						case 12:
							{
								//  030 - 1번째 자리가 "2", "7", "9" 인 경우
								var rule030_1 = ['2', '7', '9'];
								var acno1 = acno.charAt(0);

								if (rule030_1.includes(acno1)) {
									rtnBankCd = '00030';
								}

								break;
							}

						// 14자리 
						case 14:
							{
								// 030 - 1, 2, 3번째 자리가 "481~489", "493" 인 경우
								var rule030_1To3 = ['481', '482', '483', '484', '485', '486', '487', '488', '489', '493'];
								var acno1To3 = acno.substr(0, 3);

								if (rule030_1To3.includes(acno1To3)) {
									rtnBankCd = '00030';
								}

								break;
							}

						default:

					}

					return rtnBankCd || '00007'; // 기본값 '00007' - 수협은행
				};

				var correctRuleMap = {
					'00011': correctRules.NH // NH농협은행_농협회원조합
					, '00012': correctRules.NH // NH농협은행_농협회원조합
					, '00007': correctRules.SH // 수협은행_수산업협동조합중앙회
					, '00030': correctRules.SH // 수협은행_수산업협동조합중앙회
				};

				return correctRuleMap[bankCd];
			};
		};

		$operationUtil.assign(this, $dateUtil, $operationUtil, $cmnUtil);
	}

					}

			}
		};

		//데이터 세팅 후 실행
		var obj,
		    bxSlider = {};

		function loadSlider() {
			/******************************************************
	  	main
	  ******************************************************/

			// main version 0.1

			/*
	  *	@Name: Common
	  */
			Object.size = function (obj) {
				var size = 0,
				    key;
				for (key in obj) {
					if (obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
						size++;
					}
				}
				return size;
			};
			obj = {
				slidersReload: function slidersReload() {
					if (bxSlider === 'undefined') {
						console.warn('bxSlider undefined');
					}
					$.each(bxSlider, function (key, val) {
						val.reloadSlider();
					});
				}
			};

			var noticeSlider = $('.bot-slide').bxSlider({
				mode: 'vertical',
				nextText: '다음',
				prevText: '이전',
				moveSlides: 1,
				pager: false,
				touchEnabled: false,
				hideControlOnEnd: true,
				stopAutoOnClick: true,
				auto: true,
				pause: 3000
			});

			$('a[href="#"]').on('click', function (e) {
				e.preventDefault();
			});

			/* @Name: BxSlider */
			var $slider = $('.tab-body .content-slide');

			$slider.each(function (index, element) {
				if (index > 0) {
					bxSlider['slider' + index] = $slider.eq(index).bxSlider({
						slideWidth: 260,
						minSlides: 3,
						maxSlides: 3,
						moveSlides: 1,
						nextText: '다음',
						prevText: '이전',
						infiniteLoop: false,
						touchEnabled: false,
						slideMargin: 10,
						hideControlOnEnd: true,
						adaptiveHeight: true,
						pager: false
					});
				}
			});

			/* @Name: Tab */
			var tabTarget = $('.content-list > li');
			tabTarget.on('click', function (e) {
				if ($(this).hasClass('active')) {} else {
					e.preventDefault();
					var inx = $(this).index();
					$(this).addClass('active').siblings().removeClass('active');
					//$(this).parents('.content-head').next('.content-body').find('> .tab-body').eq(inx).addClass('active').siblings().removeClass('active');

					/*장영실 1줄*/
					$(this).parents('.content-head').next('.content-body').find('> .tab-body').eq(inx).addClass('active').siblings().removeClass('active');
					obj.slidersReload();
					sliderLeft();
				}
			});

			$('.section4 .content-list > li').on('click', function () {
				switch ($(this).index()) {
					case 0:
						$('.section4 .content-tit').html('<strong>무엇이</strong><br><strong>궁금</strong>하세요?');
						break;
					case 1:
						$('.section4 .content-tit').html('상담신청을 해주시면,<br><strong>빠른 시간내에 답변</strong> 드리겠습니다.');
						break;
				}
			});

			sliderLeft();
		}

		function sliderLeft() {
			$('.tab-body.active').find('.bx-wrapper').attr('style', 'max-width:' + $('.tab-body.active').find('.bx-wrapper').css('max-width'));
		}

		// Talk 설정
		function evtFloatingPopup() {
			$popupService.cmnPopOkkytalk($scope);
		}

		//custFaq 이동
		function evtCustFaq() {
			$utilService.go('/custFaq', { srchText: $scope.data.srchText, menuCd: '00178' });
		}

		//보험Dtl 이동
		function evtInsrDtl(sqno, mnCd) {
			if (mnCd == "00331") {
				$utilService.go('/gdsInsrSvngDtl', { insrGdsSqno: sqno, menuCd: mnCd });
			} else if (mnCd == "00332") {
				$utilService.go('/gdsInsrAntyDtl', { insrGdsSqno: sqno, menuCd: mnCd });
			} else if (mnCd == "00333") {
				$utilService.go('/gdsInsrGrdsDtl', { insrGdsSqno: sqno, menuCd: mnCd });
			}
		}

		//페이지 이동
		function evtMoveToPage(url, param) {
			$utilService.go(url, param);
		}

		//영업점조회
		function evtBsbr(a, b, c) {
			if (bsbrYn != 'N') {
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SMainGdsMang', operation: 'getMainBsbrList' })).then(function (data) {
					$scope.bsbrData01Count = data.SMainGdsMang01OutDto.bsbrTotalCount; // 영업점 건수 세팅
					$scope.bsbrData01 = data.SMainGdsMang01OutDto.bsbr01;
					$timeout(function () {
						if (obj && typeof obj.slidersReload !== 'undefined') obj.slidersReload();
					}, 500);
				});
			} else {
				bsbrYn = 'Y';
			}
		}

		function totMenuConvertToMap(data) {
			var menuList = [];
			var menuMap = {};
			var beforeMenuCd = "";
			var arrDataNum = 0;
			var setDataNum = 0;

			if (data) {

				for (var m = 0; m < $scope.menuCdList.length; m++) {
					menuList.push({ filePathNm: '', gdsNm: 'top', lonGdsSqno: '', lonHghsAmt: '', menuCd: $scope.menuCdList[m].menuCd, menuUrl: '', smryCont: '' });
					menuList[m]['subList'] = [];

					$.each(data, function (idx) {
						if (data[idx].menuCd == $scope.menuCdList[m].menuCd) {
							menuList[m]['subList'].push(data[idx]);
						}
					});
				}
			}

			return menuList;
		}

		//엔터 이벤트 처리
		function evtEnterClick(e) {
			var keyCode = e.which || e.keyCode;
			if (keyCode === 13) {
				evtCustFaq();
			}
		}

		$scope.event.init();
	}

		// =================================
		// 이벤트 설정
		// =================================
		function setEvent() {
			// ---------------------------------
			// 상품안내
			// ---------------------------------

			// 대출/예.적금 상품 탭
			mainTabFnc('.product-select-tab .tab-title');

			$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3); //대출 전용 변수 - 기존 변수
			$scope.slctCdsListDeposit = new Array(2); //예금 전용 변수 - 신규 생성

			// OK 맞춤상품 대출/예.적금 탭 클릭
			$('.tab-title').on('click', function () {
				$('.product-select-tab a.tab-title').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
				$(this).attr('aria-expanded', 'true');

				$scope.slctGubn = $(this).data('gubn');

				//선택항목이 초기화되지않는 상황에 배열만 초기화되다보니 오동작이 발생함
				//	        	$scope.slctCdsList = null;
				//	        		
				//	        	if (gubn == "lon") {
				//	        		$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3);
				//	        		
				//	        	} else if (gubn == "deposit") {
				//	        		$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(2);
				//	        	}
			});

			$('.product-select-tab .active a.tab-title').trigger('click');

			// OK 맞춤상품 조회조건 담기
			$('button.btn-product-select').on('click', function () {

				var step = $(this).find('span.txt-sel').data('step');
				var value = $(this).find('span.txt-sel').data('value');
				var index = Number(step) - 1;

				if ($scope.slctGubn == 'lon') {

					if ($scope.slctCdsList == null) {
						$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3);
					}

					//사용하는 속성만 남기고 내용을 비운다
					for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
						if (i >= index) {
							$scope.slctCdsList[i] = null;
						}
					}

					$scope.slctCdsList[index] = value;

					if (Number(step) === 3) {
						searchProduct(step);
					} else {
						var stepHtml = '<span aria-label="3단계 중 ' + (step + 1) + '단계">' + (step + 1) + '/3</span>';
						$('#lon_cur_step').html(stepHtml);
					}
				} else if ($scope.slctGubn == 'deposit') {

					if ($scope.slctCdsListDeposit == null) {
						$scope.slctCdsListDeposit = new Array(2);
					}

					//사용하는 속성만 남기고 내용을 비운다
					for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
						if (i >= index) {
							$scope.slctCdsListDeposit[i] = null;
						}
					}

					$scope.slctCdsListDeposit[index] = value;

					if (Number(step) === 2) {
						searchProduct(step);
					} else {
						var stepHtml = '<span aria-label="2단계 중 ' + (step + 1) + '단계">' + (step + 1) + '/2</span>';
						$('#deposit_cur_step').html(stepHtml);
					}
				}
			});

			// ---------------------------------
			// 사회공헌
			// ---------------------------------

			// 사회공헌 card 클릭 이벤트
			cardFnc('.contrib-card');

			// ---------------------------------
			// 은행소식
			// ---------------------------------


			// ---------------------------------
			// 금융소비자보호
			// ---------------------------------


			// ---------------------------------
			// FOOTER 함수
			// ---------------------------------
			$('.family-area').click(function () {
				$('.family-site').toggleClass('active');
				$('.family-area').toggleClass('on');
				$('.family', $(this).parent()).slideToggle();
				if ($(this).hasClass('on')) {
					$(this).attr('aria-expanded', true);
				} else {
					$(this).attr('aria-expanded', false);
				}
				return false;
			});

			$('.family').mouseleave(function () {
				$(this).slideUp();
				$('.family-site').removeClass('active');
				$('.family-area').removeClass('on');
				$('.family-area').attr('aria-expanded', false);
			});
		}

		// =================================
		// Talk 설정
		// =================================
		function evtFloatingPopup() {
			$popupService.cmnPopOkkytalk($scope);
		}

		// =================================
		// PAGE 이동
		// =================================
		function evtCommonMoveToPage(url, param) {

			if (url) {

				if (url.indexOf('http:/') >= 0 || url.indexOf('https:/') >= 0) {
					window.open(url, '_blank');
				} else {
					$utilService.go(url, param);
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================
		// 엔터 이벤트 처리
		// =================================
		function evtEnterClick(e) {
			var keyCode = e.which || e.keyCode;

			if (keyCode === 13) {
				evtCustFaq();
			}
		}

		// =================================	
		// 전체메뉴 MAP 형태 변환
		// =================================
		function renewalTotMenuConvertToMap(data, pMenuData) {

			var menuData = pMenuData;
			var menuList = [];
			var menuMap = {};

			if (data) {

				$.each(menuData, function (menuIdx) {

					$.each(data, function (idx) {

						if (menuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'] == data[idx]['menuCd']) {
							menuList.push(data[idx]);
						}
					});
				});

				$.each(data, function (idx) {

					if (!data[idx]['subList']) {
						data[idx]['subList'] = [];
					}

					if (menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]) {
						menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]['subList'].push(data[idx]);
					}

					menuMap[data[idx].menuCd] = data[idx];
				});
			}

			return menuList;
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시 하위에 첫번째 url이 걸린 menuCd 반환.
		// ====================================	
		function getFirstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
			var resultMenuCd = '';

			var firstMenuCd = function firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
				var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCd];
				var preIdx = 0;

				for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo['subMenuList'].length; i++) {

					if ($scope.allMenuList[menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd]['subMenuList'].length) {
						firstMenuCd(menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd);
					}

					if (!resultMenuCd) {
						if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].leafYn === 'Y' && menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuUrl) {
							resultMenuCd = menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			};

			firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd);

			return resultMenuCd;
		};

		// #####################################################################
		// 상품안내
		// #####################################################################


		// =================================
		// OK 맞춤 상품 조회
		// =================================
		function searchProduct(step) {

			var noneSeachHtml = '';

			noneSeachHtml = noneSeachHtml + '<div class="not-result">';
			noneSeachHtml = noneSeachHtml + '	<button type="button" class="btn-re-select">다시선택</button>';
			noneSeachHtml = noneSeachHtml + '</div>';

			if (Number(step) < 2) {
				return;
			}

			// 대출상품 조회
			if ($scope.slctGubn == 'lon') {

				$scope.data.slctCdsList = getSlctCdsList();

				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SLonMainMang2', operation: 'getMdorLonGdsMpngList' })).then(function (data) {

					var addHtml = '';

					if (data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto && data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto.sub) {
						$scope.listCnt = data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto.sub.length;
						$scope.mdorGdsList = data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto.sub;

						if ($scope.listCnt > 0) {

							$('#lon_product_content').html('');
							$('#deposit_product_content').html('');

							addHtml = addHtml + '<div class="result-card-slide">';

							$.each($scope.mdorGdsList, function (idx) {

								addHtml = addHtml + '	<div class="slide-cont">';
								addHtml = addHtml + '		<h4>' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['gdsNm'] + '</h4>';
								addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt1">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['smryCont'] + '</p>';

								if ($scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] == '0' || $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lonHghsAmt'] == '0') {
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last">한도<span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m"> 상품참조</span></span></p>';
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2">금리<span class="ff-apro-m"> 상품참조</span></p>';
									//			    				addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2"> <span class="ff-apro-m"> </span></p>';
								} else if ($scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] == $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['hghsRti']) {
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last">최대 <span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lonHghsAmt'] + '</span>만원</span></p>';
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2">연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
									//	    	    				addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2"> <span class="ff-apro-m"> </span></p>';
								} else {

		function getSlctCdsList() {

			var strResult = '';
			var comma = ',';
			var maxLength = $scope.slctCdsList.length - 1;

			var result = new Array();

			$.each($scope.slctCdsList, function (idx) {

				if (idx < maxLength) {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx] + comma;
				} else {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx];
				}
			});

			result.push(strResult);

			return result;
		}

		function evtLonLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, lonGdsSqno) {

			if (menuUrl) {

					$utilService.go(menuUrl);
				}
			}

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	function __factory($rootScope, $timeout, $q, $sessionStorageService, env, httpHeader, utmFactory, $commonService, $utilService) {

		var chnlCd = "HM70A"; // OKB HOM: HM70A, MW70A MA70A
		var chnlDvcd = "HOM"; // 채널구분코드
		var nologgerArray = ['확인', '닫기', '검색', '이동', '선택']; //	 로그를 남기지 않을 이벤트명

		var sessionStorage = window.sessionStorage;

		var factory = {};

		factory.init = init;
		factory.logView = logView;
		factory.logException = logException;
		factory.setMbrId = setMbrId; //	로그인 시 호출하여 저장
		factory.setCustNm = setCustNm; //	고객명 발생시(실명인증, 로그인) 호출하여 저장
		factory.setLonRcvNo = setLonRcvNo; //	대출접수번호 발생시 호출하여 저장
		factory.setCustNo = setCustNo; //	고객번호 발생시 호출하여 저장

		factory.setLonNo = setLonNo; //	대출번호 발생시 호출하여 저장

		init();

		return factory;

		function isLoaded(_solution) {
			try {
				if (typeof eval(_solution) === 'undefined') {
					console.log('로그 수집 솔루션 라이브러리가 로드되지 않았습니다.');
					return false;
				}
			} catch (e) {
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		function setSplunkExtraData() {
			if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
				splunkLoggingHec.addExtraData('comCd', 'OKB');
				splunkLoggingHec.addExtraData('chnlCd', chnlCd);

				if (utmFactory.get('cookId')) {
					splunkLoggingHec.addExtraData('gaCid', utmFactory.get('cookId'));
				}

				if (utmFactory.get('utm_key')) {
					splunkLoggingHec.addExtraData('gaUid', utmFactory.get('utm_key'));
				}
			}
		}

		function setSplunkData(appData) {
			setSplunkExtraData();

			var data = {
				cookId: utmFactory.get('cookId'),
				url: httpHeader.getCurUrl(),
				title: document.title,
				mbrId: getMbrId(),
				custNm: getCustNm(),
				lonRcvNo: getLonRcvNo(),
				custNo: getCustNo(),
				custMnno: getCustMnno(),
				lonNo: getLonNo(),
				chnlDvcd: chnlDvcd
			};

			return $.extend({}, data, appData);
		}

		function init() {
			$rootScope.addExceptionHandler = function (error) {
				factory.logException(error.exception, error.cause);
			};

			$rootScope.$on('$stateChangeSuccess', function (event, toState, toParams, fromState, fromParams) {
				console.log('logFactory $stateChangeSuccess');
				factory.logView(toState, fromState);

				// header
				httpHeader.setCurUrl(toState.url);
			});

			window.onbeforeunload = function (e) {
				var data = setSplunkData({ eventTarget: 'window', eventName: 'beforeunload' });
				if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
					splunkLoggingHec.logEvent((0, _stringify2.default)(data));
				}
			};

			document.onkeydown = function (e) {
				var keyCode = e.keyCode;
				if (keyCode == 116 || e.ctrlKey == true && keyCode == 82 || e.ctrlKey == true && keyCode == 116) {

					var data = setSplunkData({ eventTarget: 'window', eventName: 'f5' });
					if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
						splunkLoggingHec.logEvent((0, _stringify2.default)(data));
					}
				}
			};

			if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(null, { service: 'SEtcMang', operation: 'getSplunkInfo' })).then(function (data) {
					if (data.SSplunkTokenOutDto) {
						var splunkParams = data.SSplunkTokenOutDto;

						splunkLoggingHec.initAndStartSessionHEC(splunkParams.url, splunkParams.token);

						var luuid = splunkLoggingHec.getLUUID();

						document.cookie = 'splunk_luuid=' + luuid;

						// header
						httpHeader.setSplunkUuid(luuid);
					}
				});
			}
		}

		function logException(exception, cause) {
			console.log('logFactory logException', exception, cause);

			setSplunkExtraData();

			if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
				splunkLoggingHec.logException(exception);
			}
		}

		function logView(toState, fromState) {
			_logView();

			$(document.body).off('click._log');
			$(document.body).on('click._log', 'button,a', function (e) {
				var eventTarget = this.tagName.toLowerCase();
				var eventName = (this.innerText || '').replace(/\n/g, '').replace(/\t/g, '');
				if (eventTarget === 'a') {
					var title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
					if (title) {
						eventName += '(' + title + ')';
					}
				}
				_logEvent(eventTarget, eventName);
			});

			function _logView() {
				if (toState.url == fromState.url) {
					return;
				}

				var data = setSplunkData({ url: toState.url, referer: fromState.url });
				if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
					splunkLoggingHec.logView((0, _stringify2.default)(data), toState.name);
				}
			}

			function _logEvent(eventTarget, eventName) {
				if (!eventName || nologgerArray.indexOf(eventName) > -1) {
					return;
				}

				var data = setSplunkData({ url: toState.url, eventTarget: eventTarget, eventName: eventName });
				if (isLoaded('splunkLoggingHec')) {
					splunkLoggingHec.logEvent((0, _stringify2.default)(data));
				}
			}
		}

		function getLog() {
			var data;
			try {
				data = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('_log'));
			} catch (e) {
				data = null;
			}
			return data || {};
		}

		function setLog(_log) {
			sessionStorage.setItem('_log', (0, _stringify2.default)(_log));
		}

		// set 과 get 각 업무에 맞게 수정 필요.

		function setMbrId(mbrId) {

		function setLonNo(lonNo) {

			setLog(log);

		function getMbrId() {
			var lgin = $sessionStorageService.get('lgin') || {};
			return getLog()['mbrId'] || lgin.mbrId || '';
		}

		function getCustNm() {
			var lgin = $sessionStorageService.get('lgin') || {};
			return getLog()['custNm'] || lgin.mbrNm || '';
		}

		function getLonRcvNo() {

		}

		function getCustNo() {

		}

			return getLog()['custMnno'] || '';
		}

		function getLonNo() {
			return getLog()['lonNo'] || '';
		}

	  * dataObj : data부분에 해당하는 model 객체
	  * header  : header 부분 ex){ application : 'OkbBeBiz', service : 'SMngmMnprMang', operation : 'getLoginChck' }
	  * option  : 서버로 보내지 말아야할 파라미터(skip) 및 bx ui로 만든 select가 있을 경우 해당 id(selectId) 셋팅 ex) { skip : 'regId,regDttm', selectId : 'selectId1,selectId2'}
	  */
		getCmnJson: function getCmnJson(dataObj, header, option, form, httpHeader) {
			var data = {};
			var replaceData = {};

			if (dataObj) {
				data = angular.toJson(dataObj);
				data = angular.fromJson(data);

				if (option) {
					if (option.skip) {
						option.skip = ',' + option.skip + ',';

						for (var key in data) {
							if (data[key] && data[key] != 'selectAll') {
								if (option.skip.indexOf(',' + key + ',') == -1) {
									if (data[key] instanceof Array == true) {
										var addArray = [];
										for (var i in data[key]) {
											if (data[key][i]) {
												addArray.push(data[key][i]);
											}
										}

										if (addArray.length) {
											replaceData[key] = addArray;
										}
									} else {
										replaceData[key] = data[key];
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					if (option.selectId) {
						var selectIds = option.selectId.split(',');

						$.each(selectIds, function () {
							if ($('#' + this)) {
								replaceData[this] = $('#' + this).val();
							}
						});
					}
				} else {
					for (var key in data) {
						if (data[key] && data[key] != 'selectAll') {
							if (data[key] instanceof Array == true) {
								var addArray = [];
								for (var i in data[key]) {
									if (data[key][i]) {
										addArray.push(data[key][i]);
									}
								}

								if (addArray.length) {
									replaceData[key] = addArray;
								}
							} else {
								replaceData[key] = data[key];
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			if (form) {
				if (form.tagName && form.tagName.toUpperCase() == "FORM") {
					var e2eData = {};

					var $form = $(form);

					if ($form.find('input[name=__E2E_UNIQUE__]').length > 0) {
						// nprotect key value
						var e2eUnique = $form.find('input[name=__E2E_UNIQUE__]').val();
						var e2eResult = $form.find('input[name=__E2E_RESULT__]').val();

						// set nprotect key value
						e2eData.__E2E_UNIQUE__ = e2eUnique;
						e2eData.__E2E_RESULT__ = e2eResult;

						// set e2e value
						$.each($form.find('input[name$=__E2E__]'), function (key, val) {
							var name = this.name;
							var value = this.value;

							e2eData[name] = value;
						});

						// set npkencrypt value
						$.each($form.find('input[npkencrypt=on]'), function (key, val) {
							var name = this.name;
							var value = this.value;

							e2eData[name] = value;
						});

						replaceData = $.extend({}, replaceData, e2eData);
					}
				}
			}

			var returnMap = {};
			httpHeader.setApplication('OkbBeBiz');
			var defaultHader = httpHeader.getHeader();

			///////////////////////

			returnMap['header'] = $.extend({}, defaultHader, header);
			returnMap['data'] = replaceData;

			return angular.toJson(returnMap);
		},

		/**
	  * -server에서 응답 온 결과에 대해 error 메세지가 있을 경우 메세지 띄움- 
	  * data    : 서버로 부터 내려온 결과값
	  * callFun : 사용자 콜백함수를 지정하면 error시 해당 함수로 data 값을 내려줌 (사용자가 직접 에러 처리가 필요한 경우 사용)   
	  */
		getErrorMsg: function getErrorMsg(data, callFun) {
			var result = true;
			var obj = this;

			data = data || {};

			if (!data['header']) {
				data = {};
				data['header'] = { rspnCd: '99999', msgCd: '99999', msgCont: '서버 접속이 안됩니다.' };
				result = false;
			} else {
				if (data['header'].rspnCd != '0') {
					result = false;
				} else {
					result = true;
				}
			}

			if (data['header'].msgCd == 'AONCMM00004' || data['header'].msgCd == 'AONCMM00003' || data['header'].msgCd == 'AONBIZ00000' || data['header'].msgCd == 'AONBIZLGIN0' || data['header'].msgCd == 'AONBIZ00048') {
				return false;
			}

			if (callFun && typeof callFun === 'function') {
				callFun(data);
				return result;
			} else {
				if (!result) {
					if (data['header'].msgCd != 'AONBIZ00028' && data['header'].msgCd != 'AONBIZ00038') {
						//obj.openAlert('['+data['header'].msgCd+']'+data['header'].msgCont);
						obj.openAlert(data['header'].msgCont ? data['header'].msgCont : '[' + data['header'].msgCd + ']');
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		},

		/**
	  * -model에 대한 필수값 여부 체크-
	  * model 		: html과 binding된 model 		
	  * checkParam 	: 필수 여부를 체크해야할 model key 값   ex) { mnprId : '로그이ID', pswr : '비밀번호'}
	  * $scope		: $scope
	  * modelNm 		: 모델문자열명	
	  */
		validateCheck: function validateCheck(model, checkParam, $scope, parentKey, openAlertOption) {
			var that = this;
			var result = true;
			var modelNm = '';
			var msg = '';
			var openAlertOption = openAlertOption ? openAlertOption : {};

			console.log('validateCheck               $scope.data == model    ', model);

			if (model && checkParam) {
				$.each(checkParam, function (key) {
					msg = '';
					var param = checkParam[key];
					var isObject = (typeof param === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(param)) === 'object';

					if (!model[key]) {
						if (isObject) {
							msg = param.msg || '[' + key + '] 값을 확인해 주십시오.';
						} else {
							msg = '[' + (param ? param : key) + '] 값은 필수 입니다.';
						}
						result = false;
					}

					if (result) {
						if (isObject) {
							$.each(param, function (pKey, value) {
								switch (pKey) {
									case 'lmtLength':
										if (model[key].length <= value) result = false;break;
									case 'email':
										if (model[key].match(/^[a-zA-Z\d]([-_.]?[a-zA-Z\d])*@[a-zA-Z\d]([-_.]?[a-zA-Z\d])*\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3}$/) === null) {
											msg = "이메일 주소를 다시 확인해주세요";result = false;break;
										}
									case 'minValue':
										if (Number(model[key] || '0') <= Number(value)) {
											result = false;
											msg = param.msg || msg;
										}
										break;
								}
							});
						}
					} else {
						if (isObject) {
							if (param.isNoMsg) msg = '';
						}
					}

					if (!result) {
						if (msg) {
							that.openAlert(msg, function () {
								if ($scope && parentKey) {
									modelNm = parentKey + '.' + key;
									if ($scope.element && $scope.element[modelNm]) {
										that.cmnElementFocus($scope.element[modelNm]);
									}
								}
							}, openAlertOption);
						}
						return false;
					}
				});
			}

			return result;
		},

		cmnElementFocus: function cmnElementFocus(obj) {
			if (obj && obj[0]) {
				obj[0].focus();
			} else {
				var tabIndex = obj.tabIndex;
				obj.tabIndex = -1;
				obj.focus();
				obj.tabIndex = tabIndex;
			}
		},

		domainCheck: function domainCheck(strValue) {
			var properDomain = ['kr', 'com', 'net', 'gov', 'mil', 'biz', 'io', 'co', 'me', 'org', 'info', 'ai', 'edu', 'im'];

			var lastDot = strValue.lastIndexOf('.');
			var domainName = strValue.substring(lastDot + 1).toLowerCase();
			var dots = strValue.split("."); // .(닷) 길 체크 (디폴트 2개)
			var domChck = properDomain.filter(function (str) {
				return str === domainName;
			}).length > 0;

			// 도메인 검증 실패일 경우
			if (!domChck) {
				return "98";
			}

			// 도메인 검증 실패일 경우
			if (dots.length < 2 || dots.length > 3) {
				return "97";
			}

			//입력을 안했으면
			if (strValue.length == 0) {
				return "99";
			}

			return "00";
		},

		isEqualAllValue: function isEqualAllValue(model, checkParamArr, checkValue) {
			var result = false;
			var values = typeof checkValue === 'string' ? [checkValue] : checkValue;

			if (model && checkParamArr) {
				$.each(checkParamArr, function (key, val) {
					if (model[val]) {
						if (values.indexOf(model[val]) == -1) {
							result = false;
							return false;
						} else {
							result = true;
							return true;
						}
					} else {
						result = false;
						return false;
					}
				});
			}

			return result;
		},
		setAllValue: function setAllValue(model, checkParamArr, setValue) {
			if (model && checkParamArr) {
				$.each(checkParamArr, function (key, val) {
					model[val] = setValue;
				});
			}
		},

		openAlert: function openAlert(msg) {
			var title = '';
			var option = {};
			var callFun;
			var funArguments = arguments;
			var elem = null;

			$.each(funArguments, function (idx) {
				if (idx > 0) {
					switch ((0, _typeof3.default)(funArguments[idx])) {
						case 'string':
							title = funArguments[idx];
							break;
						case 'object':
							var obj = funArguments[idx];
							if (obj && obj.target) {
								elem = obj.target;
							} else {
								option = obj;
							}
							break;
						case 'function':
							callFun = funArguments[idx];
							break;
					}
				}
			});

			var defaultTitle = '알람';
			var defaultOption = {
				width: 400,
				confirmText: '확인',
				dimStyle: { color: 'clear' }
			};

			$.extend(defaultOption, option);

			/* 팝업시 스크롤 영역 유지는 없던걸로.
	   * 퍼블과 상성이 안맞음.
	  var visibleScroll = false;
	      	if ($(window).height() < document.body.scrollHeight) {
	    		document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'scroll';
	    		document.body.style.overflow = 'scroll';
	    		document.body.scroll = "yes"; 
	      		visibleScroll = true;
	    	}
	    	*/

			var dialog = $().bxDialog(defaultOption).alert({
				title: title ? title : defaultTitle,
				content: msg ? msg : '정의되지않은 오류가 발생하였습니다.',
				onConfirm: function onConfirm(e) {
					if (callFun) callFun();
					if (elem) {
						$(elem).focus();
					}
					/*
	    if (visibleScroll) {
	    	document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'auto';
	      		document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
	      		document.body.scroll = "no";
	    }
	    */
				}
			});

			$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap').attr('tabindex', '0').focus();

			if (!option.skipAlertFocusEvt) {
				//실명인증 이름 벨리데이션체크 알림창 확인버튼시 인증버튼 화면으로 포커스 잡히는 문제로 이한 예외처리
				$(dialog.$dialogWrap.context).find('.bx-btn-txt.confirm').attr('tabindex', '0').focus();

				$(dialog.$dialogWrap.context).find('.-bx-ui-dialog').find('button').on('click', function (e) {
					$('body').css('overflow', 'auto');
				});

				$('.btn-thenet.small .bx-button').first().addClass('focus');
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap .bx-btn-txt').on('click', function (e) {
					setTimeout(function () {
						$('.btn-thenet.small .bx-button').first().attr('tabindex', '0').focus().removeClass('focus');
					}, 50);
				});

				$('.ari-down .ari-down-cont .down-btn > li button').on('click', function (e) {
					$('this').addClass('focus');
				});
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap .bx-btn-txt').on('click', function (e) {
					$('.ari-down .ari-down-cont .down-btn > li button.focus').attr('tabindex', '0').focus().removeClass('focus');
				});

				$('.url-copy .bx-button').addClass('focus');
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap').attr('tabindex', '0').focus();
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap').focus();
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap.d-type6 .bx-btn-txt.confirm').on('click', function (e) {
					$('.url-copy .bx-button').attr('tabindex', '0').focus().removeClass('focus');
				});
			}

			return dialog;
		},

		openConfirm: function openConfirm(msg) {
			var title = '';
			var option = {};
			var callFun;
			var cancleFun;
			var funArguments = arguments;
			var funCnt = 0;

			$.each(funArguments, function (idx) {
				if (idx > 0) {
					switch ((0, _typeof3.default)(funArguments[idx])) {
						case 'string':
							title = funArguments[idx];
							break;
						case 'object':
							option = funArguments[idx];
							break;
						case 'function':
							if (funCnt == 0) {
								callFun = funArguments[idx];
							} else {
								cancleFun = funArguments[idx];
							}
							funCnt = funCnt + 1;
							break;
					}
				}
			});

			var defaultTitle = '알람';
			var defaultOption = {
				width: 400,
				confirmText: '확인',
				closeText: '취소',
				dimStyle: { color: 'clear' }
			};

			$.extend(defaultOption, option);
			var dialog = $().bxDialog(defaultOption).confirm({
				title: title ? title : defaultTitle,
				content: msg ? msg : '정의되지않은 오류가 발생하였습니다.',
				onConfirm: function onConfirm() {
					if (callFun) callFun();
				},
				onClose: function onClose() {
					if (cancleFun) cancleFun();
				}
			});

			if (!option.skipAlertFocusEvt) {
				//실명인증 알림창 확인버튼시 인증버튼 화면으로 포커스 잡히는 문제로 이한 예외처리
				$('body').find('.-bx-ui-dialog').find('button').on('click', function (e) {
					$('body').css('overflow', 'auto');
					$('.bx-button.focus').focus().removeClass('focus');
				});

				$('.btn-thenet.small .bx-button').addClass('focus');
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap .bx-btn-txt').on('click', function (e) {
					$('.bx-button.focus').attr('tabindex', '0').focus().removeClass('focus');
				});

				$('.ari-down .ari-down-cont .down-btn > li button').on('click', function (e) {
					$('this').addClass('focus');
				});
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap .bx-btn-txt').on('click', function (e) {
					$('.ari-down .ari-down-cont .down-btn > li button.focus').attr('tabindex', '0').focus().removeClass('focus');
				});

				$('.url-copy .bx-button').addClass('focus');
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap').attr('tabindex', '0').focus();
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap').focus();
				$('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap.d-type6 .bx-btn-txt.confirm').on('click', function (e) {
					$('.url-copy .bx-button').attr('tabindex', '0').focus().removeClass('focus');
				});
			}

			return dialog;
		},

		setCookie: function setCookie(key, value, day, path, domain) {
			var defaultOption = {};

			defaultOption['path'] = '/';
			if (isNaN(day) || day > 0) {
				defaultOption['expires'] = day ? day : 1;
			}

			if (path) defaultOption['path'] = path;
			if (domain) defaultOption['domain'] = domain;

			$.cookie(key, value, defaultOption);
		},

		getCookie: function getCookie(key) {
			return $.cookie(key);
		},

		removeCookie: function removeCookie(key) {
			if ($.cookie(key)) {
				$.cookie(key, '', { expires: -1 });
			}
		},

		//화면 Dimmed 처리 - 딤 처리 후 
		dimmed: function dimmed(obj, option) {
			option = option ? option : {};
			var parentObj = this;

			var defaultOption = {
				color: 'black',
				enableBlur: true,
				enableIcon: true,
				iconType: 'dribble',
				text: '로딩중입니다.'
			};

			if (obj && (typeof obj === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(obj)) === 'object') {
				option = $.extend({}, defaultOption, option);
				return {
					currtDim: null,
					show: function show() {
						var that = this;
						obj.bxToggle({
							onRender: function onRender() {
								if (parentObj.currtDim) {
									parentObj.currtDim.hide();
									if (parentObj.currtDim.focusElem) {
										parentObj.currtDim.focusElem.focus();
									}
								}

								parentObj.currtDim = this.$root.bxDim(defaultOption).show();
								$(parentObj.currtDim.$container).find('p').css('overflow-y', 'hidden');
								console.warn('Calling onRender Callback func in toggleInit');

								var $focus = $('*:focus');
								if ($focus) {
									parentObj.currtDim.$focusElem = $focus;
									$('*:focus').blur();
								}
							}
						}).render();
					},

					hide: function hide() {
						if (parentObj.currtDim) {
							parentObj.currtDim.hide();
							if (parentObj.currtDim.$focusElem) {
								console.log('dim focus', parentObj.currtDim.$focusElem);
								if ($('.bx-paper-wrap.ui-draggable').length > 0) {
									setTimeout(function () {
										if ($('.-bx-ui-dialog .dialog-wrap').length == 0) {
											$('.bx-paper-wrap.ui-draggable').last().focus();
										}
									}, 100);
								} else {
									parentObj.currtDim.$focusElem.focus();
								}
							}
						}
					}
				};
			} else {
				return { show: function show() {
						console.log('대상 객체가 없습니다.');
					}, hide: function hide() {
						console.log('대상 객체가 없습니다.');
					} };
			}
		},

		//체크박스에 값에 따른 기본 체크를 해줘야 하는 경우
		getDefaultChecked: function getDefaultChecked(data, checkCodes) {
			var restulData = [];

			if (data) {
				if ((typeof checkCodes === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(checkCodes)) === 'object') {
					checkCodes = checkCodes.join(',');
				}

				var checkCodeMap = {};

				if (checkCodes.indexOf(',') > 0) {
					var checkCodeArray = checkCodes.split(',');

					$.each(checkCodeArray, function (idx) {
						checkCodeMap[checkCodeArray[idx]] = 'Y';
					});
				} else {
					checkCodeMap[checkCodes] = 'Y';
				}

				$.each(data, function (idx) {
					var copyData = $.extend(true, {}, data[idx]);
					if (checkCodeMap[copyData.value]) {
						copyData['ng-checked'] = true;
					} else {
						copyData['ng-checked'] = false;
					}
					restulData.push(copyData);
				});
			}

			return restulData;
		},

		// bind드된 모델 체크박스 선택값 세팅
		setSelected: function setSelected(data, setData) {
			var checkData = {};

			data.filter(function (x, i) {
				for (var j = 0; j < setData.length; j++) {
					if (x.value == setData[j]) {
						checkData[i] = x.value;
						break;
					}
				}
			});

			return checkData;
		},

		setObjDataAdd: function setObjDataAdd(obj, name, value) {
			if (obj) {
				obj[name] = value;
			}
			return obj;
		},

		setUnderToCamel: function setUnderToCamel(str) {
			return str.toLowerCase().replace(/(\_[a-z])/g, function (arg) {
				return arg.toUpperCase().replace('_', '');
			});
		},

		setCamelToUnder: function setCamelToUnder(str) {
			return str.replace(/([A-Z])/g, function (arg) {
				return "_" + arg.toLowerCase();
			}).toLowerCase();
		},

		replaceAll: function replaceAll(value, replaceVal, descVal) {

			if (value && replaceVal) {
				var regExp = new RegExp(replaceVal, 'g');
				value = value.replace(regExp, descVal ? descVal : '');
			}

			return value;
		},

		/**
	  * 그리드에서 사용하는 체크박스에 대한 값을 반환함 
	  * grid : grid 객체
	  * key  : 반환해야할 그리드 키값
	  */
		getGridCheckboxVal: function getGridCheckboxVal(grid, key) {
			var resultVal;

			if (grid) {
				try {
					resultVal = [];
					$.each(grid.getSelectedData(), function (idx) {
						resultVal.push(grid.getSelectedData()[idx][key]);
					});
				} catch (e) {
					resultVal = null;
				}
			}
			return resultVal ? resultVal.join(',') : '';
		},

		//레이어 팝업 생성
		openLayerPopup: function openLayerPopup($scope, $compile, option, paperParam) {

			var obj = this;
			if (!$scope) {
				obj.openAlert('$scope객체는 필수 입니다.');
				return;
			}

			if (!$compile) {
				obj.openAlert('$compile객체는 필수 입니다.');
				return;
			}

			var defaultOption = {
				width: 800,
				height: 400,
				title: '팝업',
				titleAlign: 'center',
				enableDrag: true,
				// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 Start
				//                onRender: function () {
				//                	console.log('=======popup onRender');
				//                },
				//                onClosed: function () {
				//                    //gridData.popup = false;
				//                	console.log('=======popup close');
				//                },
				// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 End
				close: false
			};

			// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 Start
			var fnOnRender = option.onRender;
			var fnOnClosed = option.onClosed;
			delete option.onRender;
			delete option.onClosed;
			// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 End

			option = $.extend({}, defaultOption, option ? option : {});

			// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 Start
			option.onRender = function () {
				//			$scope.$broadcast('gaFactory.sendEvent', this.$container, option);
				if (window.gaFactory) {
					window.gaFactory.callSendEvent(this.$container, option);
				}

				this.bfElem = $(document.activeElement);
				if (typeof this.orgOnRender == "function") this.orgOnRender(this);

				if ($('.bx-paper-wrap.ui-draggable').length > 0) {
					setTimeout(function () {
						obj.cmnElementFocus($('.bx-paper-wrap.ui-draggable').last());
					}, 100);
				}
			};
			option.onClosed = function () {
				var that = this;
				var bfElem = this.bfElem;
				if (typeof this.orgOnClosed == "function") this.orgOnClosed(this);
				if ($(".bx-paper-wrap").length > 0) {
					this.timer = setTimeout(function () {
						clearTimeout(that.timer);
						if (bfElem) obj.cmnElementFocus(bfElem);else obj.cmnElementFocus($(".bx-paper-wrap").last());
					}, 50);
				} else {
					if (this.bfElem) obj.cmnElementFocus(this.bfElem);
				}
			};
			// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 End

			if (!option['template'] && !option['templateUrl']) {
				obj.openAlert('레이어 팝업 템플릿 정보는 필수 입니다.');
				return;
			}

			var paper = $().bxPaper(option);
			// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 Start
			paper.orgOnRender = fnOnRender;
			paper.orgOnClosed = fnOnClosed;
			// SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 End
			if (paperParam) {
				$scope.dynamicParam = {};
				$scope['dynamicParam'][paperParam] = paper;
			} else {
				$scope.pager = paper;
			}

			$scope.popData = option.params || {};

			$scope.popData['width'] = option.width;
			$scope.popData['height'] = option.height;

			paper.render($compile, $scope);

			$().bxButton().initialize();

			if (option.close) {
				$(paper.$paperWrap.context).addClass('btn-close');
			}
			/* bx close 활성화로 주석
	  $(paper.$paperWrap.context).find('.bx-btn-close').on('click.close', function(e) {
	  	paper.close();
	  });
	  */

			obj.cmnElementFocus(paper.$paperWrap); // SR_166253 온라인채널 웹 접근성 개발 요청서

			return paper;
		},

		openWindowPopup: function openWindowPopup($window, $scope, path, option, center) {

			$window.$windowScope = $scope;
			$window.childWindowValue = $scope;

			var defaultOption = {
				width: 700,
				height: 400,

			if (center) {
				var wLeft = window.screenLeft ? window.screenLeft : $window.screenX;
				var wTop = window.screenTop ? window.screenTop : window.screenY;

				var left = wLeft + window.innerWidth / 2 - option.width / 2;
				var top = wTop + window.innerHeight / 2 - option.height / 2;

				console.log('$window  left================================> ', left);
				console.log('$window  top================================> ', top);

				option['top'] = top;
				option['left'] = left;
			}

			var str = [];
			var target = '_blank';

			$.each(option, function (key) {
				if (key != 'target') {
					str.push(key + '=' + option[key]);
				} else {
					target = option[key];
				}
			});

			console.log('openWindowPopup   option=================> ', str.join(','));
			path = path.indexOf('#') === 0 ? path : '#' + path;

			var windowObj = $window.open(path, target, str.join(','));
			/*
	  var interval = setInterval(function() {
	  	if (windowObj) {				
	  		windowObj.document.title = 'OK저축은행 팝업창';
	  	} else {
	  		clearInterval(interval);
	  	}

	        */
			var resultMap = {
				windowObj: windowObj,
				close: function close() {
					console.log('===============close==================');
					this.windowObj.close();
				}
			};

			return resultMap;
		},

		//패스워드 설정 시 패턴 체크
		passPatternChk: function passPatternChk(value) {
			var obj = this;

			if (value) {
				value = obj.replaceAll(value, '\\s');
				if (/^(?!.*[A-Z])(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[\[\]{}()<>?|`:;~!@#$%^&*_,.+\\])(?=.*[0-9]).{6,16}$/.test(value) == false) {
					//			if(/^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[0-9]).{6,18}$/.test(value) == false){
					obj.openAlert('영문,특수문자,숫자 반드시 하나 이상 포함 되어야 하며 6자 이상 16자 이하여야 합니다.');
					return false;
				} else {
					return true;
				}
			} else {
				return false;
			}
		},

		//이메일 패턴 체크
		emadrPatternChk: function emadrPatternChk(value) {
			var obj = this;

			if (value) {
				value = obj.replaceAll(value, '\\s');
				if (/^[0-9a-zA-Z]([-_\.]?[0-9a-zA-Z])*@[0-9a-zA-Z]([-_\.]?[0-9a-zA-Z])*\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3}$/i.test(value) == false) {
					return false;
				} else {
					return true;
				}
			} else {
				return false;
			}
		},

		getNgModel: function getNgModel($scope, modelStr, type) {
			var ngObject;
			var lastStr = '';

			if (modelStr.indexOf('.') > 0) {
				modelStr = modelStr.split('.');
				for (var i = 0; i < modelStr.length; i++) {
					if (i == 0) {
						ngObject = type === 'parent' ? $scope.$parent[modelStr[i]] : $scope[modelStr[i]];
					} else if (i == modelStr.length - 1) {
						lastStr = modelStr[i];
					} else {
						ngObject = ngObject[modelStr[i]];
					}
				}
			} else {
				lastStr = modelStr;
				ngObject = type === 'parent' ? $scope.$parent : $scope;
			}

			return { lastStr: lastStr, model: ngObject };
		},
		getUrlCopy: function getUrlCopy() {
			var text = document.location;
			var $temp = $("<input>");
			$("div.uni").append($temp);

			$temp.val(text).select();
			document.execCommand('copy');
			$temp.remove();
		},

		getUUid: function getUUid() {
			var obj = this;
			return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function (c) {
				var r = obj.getRandom() * 16 | 0,
				    v = c == 'X' ? r : r & 0x3 | 0x8;return v.toString(16);
			});
		},

		getStrParamMap: function getStrParamMap(value, outKey) {
			var resultParam = {};
			var paramMap = function paramMap(value) {
				var value = value.split('?');
				var _d = value.length == 1 ? value[0] : value[1];
				var _p = _d.split('&');

				var params = {};
				for (var i = 0; i < _p.length; i++) {
					params[_p[i].split('=')[0]] = _p[i].split('=')[1];
				}
				return params;
			};

			if (value && outKey) {
				var param = paramMap(value);
				if (param) {
					var outKeyArray = outKey.split(',');
					for (var i = 0; i < outKeyArray.length; i++) {
						resultParam[outKeyArray[i]] = param[outKeyArray[i]] ? param[outKeyArray[i]] : '';
					}
				}
			}

			return resultParam;
		},

		getNumberDecode: function getNumberDecode(encodeStr, outWhsnSqno) {
			encodeStr = decodeURIComponent(encodeStr);
			var decStr = [];
			var key = ~~outWhsnSqno.substr(outWhsnSqno.length - 1);
			key = key || 1;

			for (var i = 0; i < encodeStr.length; i++) {
				decStr.push(String.fromCharCode(encodeStr.charCodeAt(i) ^ key));
			}
			return decStr.join('');
		},

		getNumberEncode: function getNumberEncode(value) {
			var encodeStr = new String(value);
			if (/^[0-9]/.test(value)) {
				var encStr = [];
				var key = ~~encodeStr.substr(encodeStr.length - 1);
				key = key || 1;

				for (var i = 0; i < encodeStr.length; i++) {
					encStr.push(String.fromCharCode(encodeStr.charCodeAt(i) ^ key));
				}
				encodeStr = encodeURIComponent(encStr.join(''));
			} else {
				encodeStr = value;
			}
			return encodeStr;
		},

		// 선택 코드 제거
		selectRemoveCd: function selectRemoveCd(pCmnCdList, pRemoveCmnCd) {

			console.log("====selectRemoveCd====", pCmnCdList, pRemoveCmnCd);

			try {

				var rtnValue; // rtnValue

				var cmnCdList; // pCmnCdList - 공통코드데이터
				var removeCmnCd; // pRemoveCmnCd - 선택코드

				cmnCdList = pCmnCdList;
				removeCmnCd = pRemoveCmnCd;

				switch (typeof removeCmnCd === 'undefined' ? 'undefined' : (0, _typeof3.default)(removeCmnCd)) {

					case 'object':

						for (var i in cmnCdList) {
							for (var j in removeCmnCd) {
								if (cmnCdList[i].value == removeCmnCd[j]) {
									cmnCdList.splice(i, 1);
								}
							}
						}

						break;

					case 'string':

						for (var i in removeCmnCd) {

							if (cmnCdList[i].value == removeCmnCd) {
								cmnCdList.splice(i, 1);
							}
						}

						break;

					default:

						break;

				}
			} catch (e) {
				rtnValue = cmnCdList;
			}

			rtnValue = cmnCdList;

			return rtnValue;
		},
		getRandom: function getRandom() {
			if (typeof Uint32Array != 'undefined' && (window.crypto || window.msCrypto)) return (window.crypto || window.msCrypto).getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] / 4294967296;else return Math.random();
		}

	var _getOwnPropertyNames = __webpack_require__(/*! babel-runtime/core-js/object/get-own-property-names */ "../../node_modules/babel-runtime/core-js/object/get-own-property-names.js");

	var _getOwnPropertyNames2 = _interopRequireDefault(_getOwnPropertyNames);

	function _interopRequireDefault(obj) { return obj && obj.__esModule ? obj : { default: obj }; }

	var app = __webpack_require__(/*! ./app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	// route 설정
	app.config(__config);

	/* @ngInject */
	function __config($stateProvider, $urlRouterProvider, $locationProvider, $httpProvider, httpHeaderConfigProvider, httpHeaderProvider, envConfigProvider, envProvider, sysLockProvider, dynamicRouteProvider, postMsgeProvider, $provide) {

	    if (!$httpProvider.defaults.headers.get) {
	        $httpProvider.defaults.headers.get = {};
	    }

	    // default header 설정
	    _setDefaultHeaderToHttpProvider($httpProvider);
	    // 정적 route state 설정
	    _setStaticRouteState($stateProvider);

	    // httpHeader 설정
	    httpHeaderProvider.setGrcmDvcd(httpHeaderConfigProvider.grcmDvcd);
	    httpHeaderProvider.setChnlDvcd(httpHeaderConfigProvider.chnlDvcd);
	    httpHeaderProvider.setDomainId(httpHeaderConfigProvider.domainId);

	    if (location.hostname.indexOf("d-www.") > -1) {
	        envProvider.setEnv(envConfigProvider.dev);
	    } else if (location.hostname.indexOf("t-www.") > -1) {
	        envProvider.setEnv(envConfigProvider.test);
	    } else if (location.hostname.indexOf("www.") > -1) {
	        envProvider.setEnv(envConfigProvider.prod);
	    }

	    sysLockProvider.setRequestUrl('serviceEndpoint/httpService/request.json');
	    sysLockProvider.setHttpHeader(httpHeaderProvider);

	    var isLock = sysLockProvider.isServiceLock();

	    // 동적 라우트 요청 url 설정
	    var dynamicRouteRequestUrl = 'serviceEndpoint/httpService/request.json';
	    // dynamicRouteProvider 에 해당 url 설정
	    dynamicRouteProvider.setRequestUrl(dynamicRouteRequestUrl);
	    dynamicRouteProvider.setHttpHeader(httpHeaderProvider);

	    // 위 url 요청 후, 데이터 반환 함수
	    var routeObject = dynamicRouteProvider.getRouteObject();
	    // routeObject 를 $stateProvider 에 설정
	    _setDynamicRouteState($stateProvider, routeObject);

	    //크로스 도메인 관련 message 이벤트 등록
	    postMsgeProvider.setMessageEvent();

	    //
	    if (isLock) {
	        // 기본 route state 설정
	        $urlRouterProvider.otherwise('/srvcInse');
	    } else {
	        // 기본 route state 설정
	        $urlRouterProvider.otherwise('/main');
	    }

	    $provide.decorator('$exceptionHandler', function ($delegate, $injector) {
	        return function (exception, cause) {
	            var $rootScope = $injector.get('$rootScope');
	            if ($rootScope && typeof $rootScope.addExceptionHandler === 'function') {
	                $rootScope.addExceptionHandler({ message: "Exception", exception: exception, cause: cause });
	            }
	            $delegate(exception, cause);
	        };
	    });
	}

	/*
	 * 기존 http default header 설정 함수

	function _setDefaultHeaderToHttpProvider($httpProvider) {
	    // IE 9 브라우저에서 ajax 호출 시, 파일이 캐시되는 문제를 위한 설정(파일의 modify 시간을 변조한다)
	    $httpProvider.defaults.headers.get['If-Modified-Since'] = 'Mon, 26 Jul 1997 05:00:00 GMT';
	    $httpProvider.defaults.headers.get['Cache-Control'] = 'no-cache';
	    $httpProvider.defaults.headers.get['Pragma'] = 'no-cache';
	}

	function _setDynamicRouteState($stateProvider, routeObject) {

	    var stateNameArray = (0, _getOwnPropertyNames2.default)(routeObject);

	    stateNameArray.map(function (stateName) {
	        var route = routeObject[stateName];

	        try {
	            if (route['popupYn'] === 'Y') {
	                $stateProvider.state('pop.' + stateName, route);
	            } else {
	                $stateProvider.state('wrap.' + stateName, route);
	            }
	        } catch (e) {
	            console.log('routekey duplicate : [' + stateName + ']');
	        }
	    });
	}
